title: An Improved Upper Bound for the Euclidean TSP Constant Using Band Crossovers
summary: Consider $n$ points generated uniformly at random in the unit square, and let $L_n$ be the length of their optimal traveling salesman tour. Beardwood, Halton, and Hammersley (1959) showed $L_n / \sqrt n \to β$ almost surely as $n\to \infty$ for some constant $β$. The exact value of $β$ is unknown but estimated to be approximately $0.71$ (Applegate, Bixby, Chvátal, Cook 2011). Beardwood et al. further showed that $0.625 \leq β\leq 0.92116.$ Currently, the best known bounds are $0.6277 \leq β\leq 0.90380$, due to Gaudio and Jaillet (2019) and Carlsson and Yu (2023), respectively.
